''See also: [[Striker techniques Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Striker]] techniques are specialized combat maneuvers characterized by a distinct input and output, typically manifesting as elongated attacks that project power outward. While they are often categorized alongside [[Enforcer techniques]]—which enhance single motions and can be more powerful but leave a user vulnerable—[[Striker]] techniques are generally slower and weaker than full-body techniques. However, they can be used to disrupt an opponent's [[madra channels]] or target their [[spirit]]. These techniques vary widely in form, ranging from simple projectiles like [[needles]], spears, or arrows to complex manifestations such as lightning, shadows, elemental breaths, or even living entities like birds and snakes. Advanced users can imbue these attacks with their own will, allowing the techniques to act with a level of autonomy similar to spirits. They can be launched from various sources, including the user's hands, weapons, or specialized [[launcher construct|launcher constructs]], and can be coordinated into massive volleys or precise, symphonic strikes.}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|[[Striker]] techniques are powerful combat methods utilized by [[Yerin's Blood Shadow]]. These attacks function by projecting power outward and are capable of being used against flying targets. During combat, [[Akura Grace]] integrates these techniques into her various attack patterns. The sheer force of the methods can scorch the air, as seen during a battle involving [[Lindon]], though [[Eithan]]'s power was once able to wipe them away.}}
